text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (August 13, 2024) for 14-16 Anglesey Boulevard.

The Property Standards Committee – Etobicoke York Panel: 1. Amended the By-law Section of Item 1 on the Property Standards Order (August 13, 2024) for 14-16 Anglesey Boulevard, Folder Number 24 196275 PRS 00 IV to 19.D.(3)(g)[1][b] OR 19.D.(3)(g)[2], and in so doing granted an extension of time to May 2, 2025 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City. 2. Confirmed Items 2, 3, 4, 5, and 6 on the Property Standards Order (August 13, 2024) for 14-16 Anglesey Boulevard, Folder Number 24 196275 PRS 00 IV.
